description: This file contains utility functions and classes for Spark ML integration, including serialization/deserialization, Java-Python object conversions, and documentation inheritance, specific to Spark MLlib.

methods.name: _to_java_object_rdd
methods.description: Converts an RDD to a Java RDD using ML serialization.

methods.name: _py2java
methods.description: Converts Python objects to Java objects, handling RDDs, DataFrames, SparkContexts, and other types.

methods.name: _java2py
methods.description: Converts Java objects back to Python objects, handling JavaRDD, Dataset, and picklable classes.

methods.name: callJavaFunc
methods.description: Calls a Java function with arguments converted from Python objects.

methods.name: inherit_doc
methods.description: Decorator to inherit docstrings from parent classes.
